notRequiredForCurrentRelease.reason: All current climate, sampling and elevation snapshots identify ERA5-Land sources. Copernicus DEM is not a scoring, elevation or sampling input in this release.

constraints: Claims remain limited to one selected 0.1-degree ERA5-Land model-grid cell.
The product is a 1991-2020 historical climatology, not a forecast or safety decision.
Grid wind remains excluded from scores, gates and best-month decisions.
Independent precipitation outliers remain withheld from recommendations.
Snow cover is converted from source percent to canonical fraction before aggregation.
Small negative precipitation and snow-depth artifacts are clamped only within the versioned -1e-6 m policy.

verifiedContract.wind: source m s-1; canonical m s-1; excluded from recommendation logic
verifiedContract.precipitation: source hourly de-accumulated m; canonical incremental per timestep m
verifiedContract.orography: geopotential z, parameter 129, m**2 s**-2, converted with g=9.80665 m s-2
